citations.claim: first violation: body centre at x=19.566 with r=0.823 extends 0.389 beyond arena
one step earlier body was still inside and moving at same vx, showing no bounce occurred at the right wall

counterfactual.change: reduced initial vx from 38.89 to 10.0 only; body then stays inside for all 22 steps, so high horizontal speed is what removes the boundary bounce

explanation: Fast body tunnels through the right arena boundary: at step 21 the centre is at x=18.95 (inside), the wall contact plane is at x=20-r=19.177, and at step 22 the centre is at x=19.566 (0.389 outside) with vx unchanged at 38.89. No impulse/bounce was applied despite 21 substeps, so the discrete boundary collision was missed and the body escaped the arena.
vision_note: The red ball moves steadily rightward toward the arena's right boundary from steps 19 to 21. In step 22 it fails to bounce and ends up embedded in and protruding beyond the right wall, slightly lower than before.
